_comment: Cross-reactivity matrix settings. Levels and ΔG conditions are NOT wet-lab calibrated — see docs/DECISIONS_crossreactivity.md.

design_request._comment: Empty groups = the backend's own defaults, the same request the validation set (validation/validate_primers.py) uses.

levels._comment: R = 2^-ΔCq_assay = p_RT × p_PCR. HIGH/MEDIUM use the assay model's CO-AMPLIFIED/PARTIAL cut-offs; LOW/NONE split at 10 Cq ≈ 0.1 % (Chen 2005: the lowest single-mismatch cross-signal it reports). NONE pairs are stored as R = 0.

dg_rt._comment: ΔG of RT-overhang : miRNA, computed with DNA:DNA nearest-neighbour parameters (primer3) on the DNA analogue — flagged approx_hybrid=True. RT buffer of Kramer 2011 Table 2 (backend constants P3_RT_*), 37 °C.

dg_pcr._comment: ΔG of the forward specific region on the off-target cDNA window (anchored register, +1 base), design qPCR conditions, at the annealing temperature.
